verdict.rationale: Freshsales documents its own REST API, authenticated with a per-user API key, for reading, modifying, adding and deleting data. This lets scripts or CI jobs drive the CRM without the UI, including bulk upserts and async job-status polling. There is no first-party CLI, no CI integration guidance and no machine-readable spec: the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes returned 404. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/automation docs or examples, OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: such as reading, modifying, adding or deleting data from your helpdesk.
Each user in Freshsales is provided with a unique API key.
